name: approach-target
title: Approach a manipulation target
description: Park the base where the right arm has a collision-free IK solution at the target's reach pose: 10 cm above an object or support, the handle pre-grasp of a door or drawer, 8 cm in front of a button.
use_when: Right before a contact action on one specific target.

not_to_be_confused_with.navigate: navigate goes to a region; approach verifies arm IK for one target.

target.description: The object, support, handle-bearing part or button to reach.

pass_by.description: Optional base waypoint: reach toward the target while driving past it.

base_pose.description: Base pose at which reachability was verified.

preconditions.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).

postconditions.meaning: From the current base pose the right TCP has a collision-free IK solution 10 cm above the target (handle pre-grasp for doors, 8 cm in front of a button).

failure.on_failure: stop and report the measured pre/postconditions; nothing is retried.
typical: no base pose reaches the target

includes: base pose search with IK + collision checks

arg_formats.entity_ref: any annotated object, support, articulated part or button
arg_formats.pose2d: a base pose [x, y, yaw_deg] in metres and degrees

returns.success: true when every precondition held, the action ran and every postcondition holds
returns.error_code: on failure: INPUT_MISSING, INPUT_UNKNOWN, PRECONDITION_FAILED, NO_PATH, POLICY_FAILED, SUBSKILL_FAILED or POSTCONDITION_FAILED
returns.preconditions: each precondition as evaluated before moving, with holds = true/false
returns.postconditions: each postcondition as evaluated after the action, with holds = true/false
returns.outputs: the measured values listed under Outputs
